patthana16.60:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho naāsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naāsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naāsavasampayutto ca naanidassanasappaṭigho naāsavasampayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.60:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naāsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
